name: Rai Way S.p.A.
summary: Rai Way S.p.A. operates as a digital infrastructure operator and service provider in Italy. The company offers broadcasting services, such as local broadcasting, and mobility and network services; and connectivity services. It also provides content delivery network services, including distribution of live and on-demand video content via protocols; Storage availability for VoD content within catalogue; transcoding service to adapt live and vod content to any device and format; protection of origin from requests for content coming from CDN caches; secure storage of live streams in the CDN's storage; and dashboard to monitor CDN services and traffic.
